shelters: Lägerplats Äskhult is the section-end official shelter/campsite, with wind shelter for 4-5 people and fireplace; toilet/water are at the nearby parking and seasonal.
Fjärås Bräcka Humlan and Biet are official shelters near the start area, but should stay pending for N2 overnight copy because Fjärås Bräcka reserve camping restrictions need explicit interpretation.
Stensjön shelter appears in the N2 official places API and Naturkartan text but is far off the current N2 GPX; suppress for N2 or import to adjacent N1/legacy context.
fireRules: Fjärås Bräcka reserve allows fires only at designated places.
Äskhult Länsstyrelsen rules say fires are prohibited, while Hallandsleden lists a fireplace at the Äskhult shelter. This is a material source conflict before public fire-use text.
Dynamic fire bans must be checked close to trip time via Krisinformation, Brandrisk Ute/MSB, municipality or Länsstyrelsen information.
campingRules: Fjärås Bräcka reserve regulations prohibit camping/tents and caravan/motorhome setup.
Äskhult culture/nature reserve rules prohibit tenting and setting up caravan/campervan.
Represent official shelters as designated amenities only; do not imply wild camping or tents in either reserve.

dogRules.summary: Use leash-required wording for reserve portions. Both Fjärås Bräcka and Äskhult prohibit unleashed dogs. Hallandsleden also gives general dog guidance for the 1 March-20 August wildlife period and for grazing areas.

hunting.summary: Hallandsleden general guidance says hunting may occur August-January; hikers may continue but should stay on marked trails, wear bright clothing, keep dogs leashed, and use arranged campsites.

livestockAndLandManagement.summary: Both reserves include grazed landscapes. Fjärås Bräcka and Äskhult visitor material notes grazing animals/paddocks; keep distance, do not feed animals, and leash pets. Äskhult has ongoing cultural-landscape restoration and may periodically look disturbed due to restoration work.

conditionReports.summary: Explicit section report for Fjärås Bräcka to Äskhults by and onward to Stättared. Notes parking at Fjärås Bräcka/Naturum, Li gravfält, heather, broadleaf forest, gravel roads, clearcuts, summer-cottage area, Skärsjön pause, optional Västra Skogs kvarn detour, final climb through conifer/beech forest, and Äskhult shelter/toilet/water. Mentions snakes in warm sunny areas and one missed marking near Äskhult after distraction.
MTB-oriented corridor discussion describes much of the route as asphalt/gravel road with some path near Äskhult, and not very rough. Treat as stale but useful corroboration of road-heavy character.
